title: Nutella Kimchi Grilled Bites
description: A sweet and spicy dessert or snack with crunchy grilled bites filled with nutella and kimchi.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium heat.
2. Mix together nutella and chopped kimchi in a small bowl.
3. Place a tablespoon of the nutella-kimchi mixture into each ice cream cone.
4. Dot the top of each cone with butter.
5. Sprinkle a pinch of sugar and salt over the top of each cone.
6. Grill the cones for 30-45 seconds on each side, until lightly toasted.
